verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic IDE that generates AI code, so license and public-code matching references are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions code referencing, license attribution, or matching AI suggestions against public code. The inline diff review is an adjacent review feature, not provenance matching, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code
